This machine doesn't enable MCTP fully, and is intended to run on a BMC (ie P3809).

Should add some details around what we're trying to do in the commit message.

Wouldn't his just be "Supports Nvidia VDM?" like Type: NvidiaMctpVDM

Given we're using VDM, this config shouldn't' need to get hyper specific per sensor.  Take a look at the XeonSocket type for another example of this.
Is the $bus relevant for an add in card?

I know I suggested this, but now I wonder what conflicts we will run into given we also have https://github.com/openbmc/entity-manager/blob/master/configurations/nvidia_gb200.json.

The board/board EEPROM is the same, but we have to distinguish between on-board vs add-in GPU card. @ed@tanous.net thoughts?
On our platform with the add in card, I don't think the add in card has its own FRU EEPROM, otherwise we could have consumed that here to PROBE as opposed to tbe board EEPROM.

@haghera@nvidia.com after looking at the platform a bit more, I think we can PROBE on the following as it corresponds to the GPU:

.PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME               property  s         "P4975"

I see the issue here:

https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/79439. Hasn't merged yet, but is likely a duplicate of this.  we probably need to merge the two?

Updating based on our offline discussion - this should just update the existing https://github.com/openbmc/entity-manager/blob/master/configurations/nvidia_gb200.json to add the new NvidiaMctpVdm type.
Remove both of these for now.  These need to be descriptive of the transport (i2c address, usb identifier etc).
This is required to "match" a GPU from the config here to what's found over MCTP VDM.
I see similar usage here (and other configs) - https://github.com/openbmc/entity-manager/blob/master/configurations/kudo_bmc.json#L212
Updating based on offline discussion - this is not needed because the same is discoverable via MCTP VDM messages.
Remove this for now.  Add back once this is supported in the backend.
Backend code is up in dbus-sensors. Wouldn't this be a chicken and egg problem?
Backend code now implements the correct sensor type.
Please add "HMC" because that's what you're probing on here.
P4975 is a GPU. Not sure I followed this comment - please clarify.
I added some details to the commit message comment on what is being probed.
nits: look at the other commit messages - you should label this as schema:. Also, this is an update, not an add.
Can't figure out the CI fail - I don't think the config actually fails schema. Retriggered the CI but that keeps running into Jenkins issues. Config LGTM.

This file is the legacy schema, why are we adding a new schemas in here?

It's new so we cannot exactly call it a "Legacy" schema.
Needs ```description``` property to describe what is being configured here.
